3:2 landscape photograph: a small running crew of seven people gathered in a loose circle on a park lawn right after a Saturday morning group run, stretching, chatting and laughing, water bottles in hand, one person high-fiving another. Seen from a slight distance and mostly from behind and the side so no face is clearly identifiable. Warm low morning sun from behind the trees, long shadows on the grass, relaxed friendly mood.
Style: real-looking candid editorial photograph for a Korean running-crew app landing page, natural light, shallow-to-medium depth of field, subtle film grain, true-to-life color (no heavy filters, no yellow color cast). Everyday anonymous runners in their 20s-30s of mixed pace and body types; faces turned away, in profile at a distance, or too small to identify. No logos on clothing, shoes or objects, no readable text, signage or numbers anywhere, no famous or recognizable landmark (buildings and bridges stay generic and hazy). No illustration, no 3D render, no watermark.
